body: Residual from lane cce2-1022u (PR beamfall/corvint#1553, seal 751a2a15d). The live NEA-V0-002 run through corvint-test accept fails with provider-infrastructure, and it fails the same way at the commit before the CTF move, so the failure predates that lane.
title: NEA-V0-002 live acceptance through corvint-test accept fails with provider-infrastructure
